decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management know-how. In-house R&D lets it read early results and refine the system.
The cleaning centrifuge builds directly on the firm's filtration expertise. The firm can therefore assimilate market feedback and improve the product.
Coolant nozzles are a natural complement to the firm's pumping and coolant systems. They draw on related knowledge the firm already holds.
Scraper belt chip conveyors sit at the heart of the firm's conveying competence. Absorptive capacity for this product is high.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor extends established conveyor engineering. In-house R&D supports learning and improvement.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are core to the firm's metalworking material flow offer. The firm can easily interpret results and refine them.
